utterances.text: It would probably be helpful, but as I said, I wouldn't like to check that myself. There are other people who can do that.

utterances.speaker: MS. D'ASCOLI
utterances.text: I understand that, sir. I was just making the point that without having a complete record and without knowing exactly how things went, you are not in a position to say what really happened, whether this was a correction enter after you finished your work was a correction entered in an inappropriate way in a different form? I was just asking you whether you would agree with this point.

utterances.speaker: DUSAN MLADENOVSKI
utterances.text: I don't understand your question entirely. What do you want me to agree with, whether this correction was appropriate. I'm sorry, I didn't understand your question.

utterances.speaker: MS. D'ASCOLI
utterances.text: No worries. I was just asking whether -- a way of clarify the matter would have been to have access to the copies, to the three copies existing of this archive list and verify whether for example the corrections at the archive unit 82 was present on the old copies, on all the copies?

utterances.speaker: DUSAN MLADENOVSKI
utterances.text: I think I already answered that question. I said that that would probably help but your next question was something with regard to corrections.

utterances.speaker: MS. D'ASCOLI
utterances.text: Thank you, sir. Those were my questions. Your Honour, I'm finished my cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. D'Ascoli. Mr. Djordjevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJORDJEVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Only one question.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJORDJEVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Are you sure that it wasn't you who made these corrections?

utterances.speaker: DUSAN MLADENOVSKI
utterances.text: When I gave my statement and when I testified in the Milutinovic case, and I'm saying it now, that it wasn't me who made this correction.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJORDJEVIC
utterances.text: Could it be that this correction was made only after you or maybe at some completely different period of time?

utterances.speaker: DUSAN MLADENOVSKI
utterances.text: I already said I'm going to reiterate that this correction may have occurred between -- after the 25th of September 1999 until the date when a photocopy of this archive list was made.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJORDJEVIC
utterances.text: No more redirect, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Djordjevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Sir, if I recall correctly, you mentioned that you had the chance to go through the whole list and count the number of documents and the number of pages. And that differed because of this correction -- this specific correction we were talking about, that differed from the whole number. When was it that you had the chance to go through the whole document?

utterances.speaker: DUSAN MLADENOVSKI
utterances.text: I think I already said this at the beginning, which is that I did that when I was giving statements to the investigator Ratko Djukanovic. I was shown the entire list at the time and that is when I did the adding up. And eventually, I found out together with the correction in entry 82 that the number of documents and the number of sheets did not correspond. So that was for the first time that I discovered this discrepancy. Without the correction of entry 82, the number of documents and the number of sheets do correspond.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: You will be pleased to know that completes the questions. Thank you for coming. Thank you for your assistance. You are free to go. When we now rise, you will be able to go off and look after your ordinary affairs. We thank counsel for the speedy treatment of this witness. We resume again on Monday at 2.15. We now adjourn.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 15th day of February, 2010, at 2.15 p.m. 24 25
